messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, go to the MSCA sign-in page and use the option you originally registered with: **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner (your bank)**, or a **provincial sign-in** where available.[4][3]

If you are having trouble, Service Canada says the sign-in method is tied to your account, so you must use the same one each time unless you register for another option.[4]

Common sign-in options:
- **GCKey**: use your GCKey username and password.[4][1]
- **Interac® Sign-In Partner**: sign in with participating online banking credentials.[4]
- **Provincial sign-in**: available in some provinces.[3][4]

If you cannot sign in, the help page says MSCA may ask you to verify identity details such as your **SIN**, date of birth, or access code, and all information must match Service Canada’s records exactly.[5]

If you want, I can also give you the **exact step-by-step sign-in path** for GCKey, bank sign-in, or provincial sign-in.
